base_prompt: Create a NEW pixel-art RPG character lineup based STRICTLY on the attached approved NPC atlas. Match its third-row captain EXACTLY in head/body ratio (head about one third of total height), shoulder width, short articulated limbs, dark eye shape, outline thickness, square pixel cluster size, restrained material shading and overall visual density. This is low-resolution pixel sprite artwork, NOT smoothly shaded digital miniatures, not realistic 3D. Each character should be designed on an approximately 48x64 logical pixel grid, then nearest-neighbor enlarged. No subpixel lines, no airbrush, no smooth gradients, no soft glows. One row of THREE isolated full-body standing characters, all same body scale and facing right three-quarter side view. Character1: male knight, short chestnut hair, olive scarf, silver plate armor, brown belt/boots, LEFT hand holds olive shield, RIGHT hand holds short silver sword. Character2: male mage, short chestnut hair, navy robe/tunic with simple brown belt, olive cape, brown gauntlets each carrying one cyan gemstone, brown boots, NO staff or weapon. Character3: female hero, blonde high ponytail, burgundy scarf and cape, silver armor, brown boots, LEFT hand holds shield bearing small gold emblem, RIGHT hand holds short silver sword. These must look like members of the exact same pixel-art set as the attached NPCs. Preserve readable pixels; do not increase rendering detail beyond reference. Genuine alpha transparency everywhere outside silhouettes, NO black/brown/gray background, NO ground, NO shadow or checkerboard. No text or labels. Large empty transparent gutters. Exactly three figures.

One uniform 4 columns by 4 rows sheet. Each sprite occupies only the central 60 percent of its cell; very wide EMPTY transparent gutters, no sword/cape/hand may cross the cell boundary. Exactly 16 full body figures, same scale and foot baseline within each cell. Side-facing RIGHT three-quarter view. Genuine alpha transparency, NO backdrop, NO shadow, NO glow, NO VFX, NO text. Equipment must remain visible and held by the correct hand; exactly two arms and two legs per character.
specs: Use ONLY the FIRST character, brown-haired male knight, olive scarf/cape, silver armor, brown boots, plain olive shield in LEFT hand and short silver sword in RIGHT hand. Row4: four sequential RIGHT sword overhead chop frames: sword raised, downward strike, low follow-through, recovery. Do NOT use both hands on sword.

Use ONLY the SECOND character, brown-haired male mage, navy robe with gold edging, olive cape, brown belt and boots, brown gauntlets with cyan gemstone mounted ON each glove. Row4 four BOTH hands forward frames: windup, both arms extending, both open palms fully extended side by side, recovery. Both arms visible; no merged hand, no third glove behind shoulder.

Use ONLY the THIRD character, blonde FEMALE hero, high ponytail, burgundy scarf/cape, silver armor, brown boots, burgundy shield with gold emblem LEFT hand, short silver sword RIGHT hand. Row4 four nonlethal reaction poses: bracing shield, hit reaction with equipment held, kneeling exhausted alive with sword lowered, standing recovered. No death or blood.
